items.title: Patch 1.4.10 lands November 25
items.dek: Nexon has set Patch 1.4.10 for November 25 at 23:00 PST. The contents haven't been announced, so plan around the update window.
body: Nexon posted a notice on November 23 that sets Patch 1.4.10 for November 25, 2026, at 23:00 PST. The notice doesn't list what's in the patch, so don't expect new descendants or skins until Nexon publishes patch notes.
The same notice gives the results of a cheating crackdown that ran November 13–19 and ended in two permanent bans.
Watch for the full patch notes on the day.

items.title: Descendant's Weekend boosts run to December 6
items.dek: +20% Descendant EXP, Weapon Proficiency and Unique Arche Factor EXP on weekends. The next window opens November 26.
body: The Descendant's Weekend event runs from November 19, 23:00 PST, to December 6, 22:59 PST. During its weekend windows you get +20% to Descendant EXP, Weapon Proficiency and Unique Arche Factor EXP.
The remaining windows are November 26–29 and December 3–6, each running from 23:00 to 22:59 PST. Save your leveling for those days.

items.title: Black Friday sale on older skins until December 3
items.dek: Skins over six months old are discounted in descendant-specific bundles through December 3.
body: Nexon announced a Black Friday sale in its November 16 developer livestream. It runs from November 17 to December 3.
Skins released more than six months ago are discounted and grouped into bundles for each descendant. If you skipped a skin earlier in the year, this is a cheaper chance to get it.

items.title: Kyle's Abyss Raptor skin is out; The Frozen One returns
items.dek: Kyle's new premium skin arrived November 17 alongside Monet's Chrono Fluid, and Ice Maiden's The Frozen One skin is coming back.
body: Kyle's premium skin "Abyss Raptor" released on November 17, together with Monet's Chrono Fluid. Nexon announced both in its November 16 developer livestream.
The same livestream summary says Ice Maiden's "The Frozen One" skin is returning. The summary doesn't give a date for its return.

items.title: Season 1 Reloaded still expected December 2
items.dek: The in-game countdown points to December 2, 10pm PT, but Activision hasn't confirmed the date yet.
body: Gamelevate (around November 21) still gives December 2, 2026, at 10pm PT (December 3, 6am GMT) for MW4 and Warzone Season 1 Reloaded. It bases this on the in-game countdown for the Season 1 Battle Pass bonus rewards, not on an announcement from Activision.
Noping says players who finish the Season 1 Battle Pass can unlock eight more operator skins during the mid-season update. Dot Esports names Ministry and Overflow as expected maps.
There is no official Call of Duty blog post yet, so treat the date as expected.

items.title: 9-CD Original Soundtrack set, pre-orders December 8
items.dek: Shift Up's 9-CD soundtrack box comes with a special outer box and a wide lenticular card. Pre-orders open December 8.
body: Shift Up has announced a Stellar Blade Original Soundtrack set on 9 CDs. It comes with a special outer box, a wide lenticular card and other extras.
Pre-orders open December 8. The release date and price haven't been given yet.

items.title: Version 3.4 confirmed for December 2
items.dek: HoYoverse's press release confirms the date, Sunbringer, a free Robin and Kafka in the second half, plus an Alice rerun.
body: HoYoverse's November 20 press release confirms that Version 3.4, "The Finality of the Day", launches on December 2. It includes Sunbringer, Robin free to claim, Robin's Cosmic Beat outfit, and Kafka in the second half of the version.
Alice gets a rerun in the second half. Her W-Engine is officially called "Practiced Perfection", even though some outlets list it under another name.
Yahoo Tech says the Sunbringer and Robin banners run from December 2 to January 12, 2027, at 2:59 PM UTC+8.

items.title: Kafka's ZZZ banner set for January 1, 2027
items.dek: Kafka, an S-Rank Electric Anomaly Agent, gets a firm banner start in 3.4's second half. Plan your pulls now.
body: Guide sites now date Kafka's debut banner, "Final Act's Nocturne," in Phase 2 of version 3.4. AccountShark gives January 1, 2027 12:00 to January 21, 2027 14:59 and credits the official Signal Search Preview. Game8 gives the same January 1 to 21 window. Her signature W-Engine, "Requiem Araneae," runs in the same phase. Kafka is a banner character, not a free login reward. Alice and her W-Engine "Practiced Perfection" return as a rerun in the same half.

Phase 1's end date is unresolved. Yahoo says the Sunbringer and Robin banners run December 2, 2026 to January 12, 2027, 2:59 PM (UTC+8). CBR says they stay open for all of 3.4. HoYoverse's own banner notice hasn't been found, and both AccountShark and Game8 are guide sites, not official sources.

items.title: Grand Major seedings out; Pick'ems lock Nov 26
items.dek: Embark's official seeding post sets the Pick'em deadline: midnight CET at the end of Thursday, November 26.
body: Embark posted the Grand Major seeding reveal on November 23. The event runs at DreamHack Stockholm, November 27 to 29. Sixteen teams from the Americas, EMEA and APAC compete for a $150,000 prize pool, and a best-of-three Grand Final decides the champion.

The only new detail is the deadline. Pick'ems lock at midnight CET at the end of Thursday, November 26, so submit your picks before then. In-game, there is no patch after 12.4.0 and no new cosmetics. Season 13 hasn't been announced, and there is no official Season 12 end date.

items.title: MW4 Season 1 — Valkyrie, XERO, and the pass
items.dek: Min-Hee, Simone and Valen in the pass; the Norse 'Hildr' skin for Valen in the store.
body: BlackCell owners get the XERO Operator instantly, plus the Cowled and Adder XERO skins through challenges. Battle Pass Operator Skins include Min-Hee 'Patience', Simone 'Collision' and Valen 'Red Eclipse'.

Store bundles include The Valkyrie Mastercraft Bundle with the Norse-mythology 'Hildr' skin for Valen, Bone Chiller II with 'Golden Wraith' for Ghost, and The Captain Bundle with 'Blackout' for Price.

items.title: Update 12.4.0: Couch Contestant Set in a refreshed Store
items.dek: A light weekly update: the Store rotates and adds the Couch Contestant Set, one week before The Grand Major.
body: Embark's Update 12.4.0 went out on November 19. Its notes are short: the update brings a refreshed Store, led by the Couch Contestant Set, a cosmetic set for players who want to show they are playing from the couch.
The notes list no balance changes or new modes. They point to The Grand Major 2026, one week out, held in Stockholm and online.

items.title: Embark apologizes for AI casters in a TGM qualifier video
items.dek: A highlight reel swapped the APAC qualifier's human casters for the game's AI announcers; Embark deleted it and apologized.
body: Ahead of The Grand Major, Embark posted a highlight reel from the APAC closed qualifiers that replaced the human casters with Scotty and June, the AI commentators from THE FINALS. The video has since been deleted.

Oscar Lundberg, Embark's community and competitive operations lead, said the aim was to draw casual interest into the game's esports before TGM, but that the casters' work "deserved to be included and highlighted, and it wasn't." Proto, one of the replaced casters, has called for industry-wide protections for commentary and production teams.

items.title: Free Viessa Medical Support skin in a 28-day login event
items.dek: The Absolute-Zero login calendar gives Ecive's Raging Blizzard skin on day 7 and Viessa's Medical Support box on day 21.
body: The 11.17 update opened the Absolute-Zero Medical Support login calendar. It counts total logins, not consecutive days, and runs until December 16, 2026. Day 7 gives Ecive's "Raging Blizzard" skin, day 21 gives Viessa's Medical Support Box with her new skin, and days 22 to 28 each give an Amorphous Material Pattern: Absolute-Zero.

Viessa's story event adds two more cosmetics: the "Fresh" makeup for starting "Urgent Summons" and the "Smuggler's Bag" back attachment for finishing "Temperature of Power". Most events from the update, including Monet's Knight's Limit Breakthrough, end December 9; Descendant's Weekend boosts run again Nov 26-29 and Dec 3-6.

items.title: Season 4 Episode 2 'Legacy' pass and shop skins
items.dek: The new battle pass tops out with the Bizarre Dream Rabbit skin; the shop adds Kyle's Abyss Raptor and Black Friday skin bundles.
body: Patch 1.4.9 on November 17 started the Season 4 Episode 2 battle pass. Premium highlights include the EXCAVA Outlaw weapon skin at level 4, Bizarre Dream Gentleman at level 68 and Bizarre Dream Rabbit at level 100. The Premium upgrade costs 500 Caliber.

The shop refresh (November 16, 23:00 PST) added Monet's Chrono Fluid, Kyle's Abyss Raptor, Ultimate Ajax and Ultimate Esiemo bundles, and Black Friday skin bundles for almost every Descendant. The Ice Maiden event adds "Frozen One" skins for Raven and Monet.

items.title: Modern Warfare 4 nominated for Best Multiplayer at The Game Awards
items.dek: MW4 is one of six Best Multiplayer nominees; winners are named December 10 in Los Angeles.
body: The Game Awards 2026 nominees were announced on November 17. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is up for Best Multiplayer against Big Walk, Gears of War: E-Day, Marathon, Meccha Chameleon and Orbitals. It has no other nominations.

The ceremony is on December 10, 2026, at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles. None of the other games followed here (THE FINALS, The First Descendant, Stellar Blade, Zenless Zone Zero) made the nominee lists.

items.title: Shift Up: Switch 2 sales on plan, Project Spirit reveal slips
items.dek: Q3 results: Stellar Blade's Switch 2 launch meets internal targets, Blood Rain is on track, and Project Spirit's reveal moves past 2026.
body: In its third-quarter results on November 10, Shift Up said the Switch 2 version of Stellar Blade, self-published worldwide on November 6, is "meeting our internal expectations." Sales on existing platforms have tapered to a steady baseline, with Stellar Blade revenue down 32.9% from the previous quarter. The free Bayonetta outfits also went to PS5 and PC players to support sales.

Development of the sequel, Stellar Blade: Blood Rain, is "progressing according to target goals," with details to come in stages. The reveal of Shift Up's next new game, Project Spirit, has moved out of 2026 to avoid major releases from other publishers; no new date was given.

items.title: Sunbringer, the first Enchainer, arrives December 2
items.dek: Version 3.4 'The Finality of the Day' launches Dec 2 with Sunbringer, an S-Rank Genesis Flare Armorer and the first Enchainer Agent.
body: HoYoverse's Version 3.4 announcement confirms that "The Finality of the Day" launches on December 2, 2026. Sunbringer is playable from day one and stays available through the whole version.

HoYoverse classifies her as an S-Rank Genesis Flare Armorer Agent. She is a new Void Hunter and the first Agent labelled an Enchainer. She shares the opening half of the version with the free crossover Agent Robin; Kafka follows in the second half.

items.title: Sunrise on the Reaping opens past $120 million
items.dek: The Hunger Games prequel is on track for Lionsgate's first $100M-plus opening since 2015, from 4,018 locations.
body: Lionsgate's The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping was heading for a $120 million-plus domestic opening weekend, per TheWrap's Saturday report, after $56 million on its opening day, including $21 million from previews, in 4,018 locations.

That would be Lionsgate's first $100 million-plus opening since Mockingjay - Part 2 opened to $102 million in 2015, ahead of the studio's earlier 2026 release Michael ($97 million). Audiences gave it an A- CinemaScore, above the 2023 prequel's B+, though the run may be front-loaded.

items.title: Fool Night anime streams on Netflix November 26
items.dek: Sunrise and Shaft's first joint series: a low-oxygen future where people are turned into plants to make air.
body: Netflix streams Fool Night from November 26, 2026. It is the first collaboration between anime studios Sunrise and Shaft. The episode count is still TBA.

In a distant future with very little oxygen, humanity survives through "floromorphosis," a controversial process that turns living people into oxygen-producing plants. Toshiro Kamiya, facing extreme poverty and his mother's serious illness, considers giving up his own body to it for a large payment.

items.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker: The Art of the Game is out
items.dek: Titan's 192-page hardcover art book for the game, with concept art and developer interviews, at $50.
body: Titan Books publishes The Blood of Dawnwalker: The Art of the Game on November 24, 2026. It is a 192-page hardcover priced at $50, written by Matthew Pellett.
The book collects hundreds of images, from early concept art to final designs, with behind-the-scenes notes and exclusive interviews on how the game was made.

suggestions.title: ARC Raiders 2.7 starts the Flickering Flames project
suggestions.dek: Embark's extraction shooter adds a festive raider project on Nov 24, after the 2.6 patch and a 50% sale for new players.
body: Live Update 2.7 is coming November 24 with Flickering Flames Part 1, a three-step raider project to help Celeste prepare a festive dinner for Toledo's four contradas. Each step pays weapons and weapon mods, and Part 2 will add cosmetic rewards. The Nessuno Set (outfit, backpack and backpack charm) is coming soon to the store.

Update 2.6 on November 17 brought back Cold Snap, let Dockmaster's Detectors find buried items on every map except Pendola Pass, and added the Outlaw Weapon Stencil Set. New players get 50% off: PlayStation Nov 16-30, Epic Nov 17-Dec 1, Xbox and Steam Nov 19-Dec 3.

suggestions.title: Apex Legends x Godzilla event runs until December 1
suggestions.dek: Ten kaiju legend skins, ten legendary weapon skins and a Dorsal Dagger melee on Storm Point, through December 1.
body: The Godzilla event runs November 10 to December 1 on Storm Point. Legend skins include Bloodhound "Godzilla 2026", Valkyrie "Mothra 2003", Wraith "Godzilla 2016", Loba "SpaceGodzilla" and Catalyst "Ghidorah 1991", and ten weapons get legendary skins.

The free event pass gives the Octane "Jet Jaguar" skin and event packs; the 950 AC premium track adds Catalyst "Ghidorah 1991" and a legendary Prowler skin. The Dorsal Dagger universal melee is a possible drop from Godzilla Event Packs.

suggestions.title: Marvel Rivals Season 11 adds Nightcrawler; 18v18 mode Nov 26
suggestions.dek: Season 11: Doomsday brought Nightcrawler and Dracula; Chrono-Annihilation, an 18 vs 18 mode, arrives with the Nov 26 update.
body: Marvel Rivals Season 11: Doomsday launched November 13. Nightcrawler joins as the new Strategist in the first half of the season, and Dracula also joins the roster this season, with no date given yet.

The November 26 update adds Chrono-Annihilation, an 18 vs 18 mode on the Incursion Point map. Anniversary events pay 2,500 Units and a free Legendary Deadpool costume. The Ignite 2026 Grand Finals run November 23 to 29 at DreamHack Stockholm, the same venue as THE FINALS' Grand Major, with a $1,000,000 prize pool.

suggestions.title: Overwatch Season 6 and new hero Hudson due in December
suggestions.dek: The in-game timer points to Dec 8; Blizzard is expected to detail the Omnic Detective, Hudson, at the OWCS World Finals.
body: Overwatch's in-game battle pass timer points to Tuesday, December 8, 2026 for Season 6, though the date could still shift. The long-teased Omnic Detective, hero 55, is confirmed to be named Hudson; Blizzard first teased him in February and showed art at BlizzCon.

His abilities are not official yet. He is understood to be a Damage hero after starting out as a Support design. More details are expected at the OWCS World Finals, December 2 to 6. A new battle pass, a Mythic skin and a Mythic weapon are also expected with the season.

suggestions.title: Marathon's Symbiosis update and free week start December 8
suggestions.dek: Bungie's extraction shooter adds Expedition, its first permanent PvE mode, a sword-wielding Bishop shell and a free open week.
body: Symbiosis arrives December 8, 2026, with an open play week through December 15 that gives new players all of Marathon's content for free.

It adds Expedition, a co-op PvE mode with roguelite upgrades called Flash Boosts; Bishop, a sword-wielding Runner shell; Limbo, a social hub with a firing range; a beta PvP Deathmatch; the Burrows and Reservoir areas in the Perimeter; and new gear such as the Maverick pistol and the V17 flamethrower.

suggestions.title: Wuthering Waves 4.0 lands December 22
suggestions.dek: Kuro's year-long 'Embers of the Everbright' arc opens in the New Federation, with seven new Resonators across the 4.x updates.
body: Kuro Games set Version 4.0 for December 22, 2026 (UTC+8) on all platforms. It opens "Embers of the Everbright," the game's Chapter of the Year, a year-long story arc.

A new 2D animated trailer shows the Western-inspired New Federation for the first time and introduces seven Resonators arriving across the 4.x updates. Kuro will reveal each one individually on social media, with more details before launch.

suggestions.title: Phantom Blade Zero earns five Game Awards nominations
suggestions.dek: The action game is up for Game of the Year and Best Action, plus direction, art and music awards.
body: The Game Awards 2026 nominees, revealed November 17, put Phantom Blade Zero in five categories: Game of the Year, Best Game Direction, Best Art Direction, Best Score and Music, and Best Action.
The nominee reveal also opened the public voting phase for the show.

suggestions.title: Neverness to Everness adds Captain Exe on December 2
suggestions.dek: Version 1.5's second new character, the hacker Exe, follows Lieutenant Elyms; the patch also added tanks and a delivery business.
body: Neverness to Everness Version 1.5, "Once Upon a Glitched Call," released November 11 with Lieutenant Elyms, who fights with her phone. Captain Exe, a hacker, follows on December 2.
Version 1.5 also added an armored cash truck, an ambulance and the Iron Ogre tank, a logistics branch you run by recruiting drivers and taking commissions, and DSD POP, a single-player board game.
